key_insight: An AI-derived focal TIL score captures localized immune infiltration on routine H&E images and was associated with overall survival in ICI-treated lung adenocarcinoma.
clinical_relevance: The score may support prognostic research using routine pathology slides, but the reported association does not establish its ability to predict benefit from immunotherapy.
method: Detect lymphocytes with a deep learning model trained on IHC-derived ground truth.
Segment tumor and adjacent stroma using a model trained on consensus pathologist annotations.
Measure tile-level lymphocyte density to capture spatially localized infiltration.
evidence_signal: Analytical validation yielded lymphocyte CCC 0.90 and segmentation Dice 0.87; in 685 ICI-treated patients, the score was associated with overall survival (HR 0.60, 95% CI 0.48–0.75; P<0.001) and reportedly outperformed PD-L1.
watch_item: Generalizability across laboratories and prospective clinical utility require further validation before routine use.
paper_title: Quantifying Localized Tumor-Infiltrating Lymphocytes by Deep Learning on H&E Images: Analytical Validation and Prognostic Value in Lung Adenocarcinoma
